About EscapeGravity

Defy physics. Reach the stars.

EscapeGravity is an immersive board game where players race to launch from Earth and reach the International Space Station. Every turn pulls you deeper into the science of spaceflight, from calculating thrust to understanding orbital mechanics.

But this is no ordinary roll-and-move game. Gravity fights back! Players face physical challenges that get them out of their chairs — balance like an astronaut, stretch to simulate zero-G manoeuvres, and demonstrate the focus needed for mission control.

Along the way, science questions from physics, biology, and astronomy test your knowledge. Answer correctly to boost your trajectory; get it wrong and gravity drags you back toward Earth.

With strategic card play, unpredictable events, and a beautifully illustrated board, every launch attempt is a unique adventure for the whole family.

2-6 Players
8+ Ages
30-60 Minutes
Science + Fun Category

Game Features

Physical Challenges

Move, stretch, balance! The board demands real-world actions that bring the game to life.

Science Learning

Questions from physics to biology. Learn while you play and boost your trajectory!

Strategic Gameplay

Plan your moves carefully. Every decision affects your orbit and your chance of reaching the ISS.

Multiplayer Fun

2-6 players race to escape gravity together. Alliances form, rivalries ignite!

Beautiful Art

Hand-illustrated cards and board bring the wonders of space to vivid life.

Replayability

Random events, shuffled cards, and branching paths make every game unique.

Be the first to know when EscapeGravity launches. Sign up for mission updates!
